To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the risk management of commodity markets can be improved by using an integrated approach, (ii) the integrated risk management of commodity market risks can be implemented in a cost–effective manner, (iii) the integrated risk analysis of commodity market risks should be performed by using a combination of quantitative and qualitative techniques, and (iv) the integrated risk control of commodity market risks is best performed by a combination of internal and external controls.

(1) commodity prices exhibit a strong mean reversion, (2) the mean reversion is stronger for the longer–term horizons (1–year and longer), and (3) there is no evidence that commodity futures prices are more volatile than commodity spot prices.
